name: An Unholy Alliance
summary: A small scroll is meant for Varimathras in the Undercity. You are carrying it to him.

sections.title: Before Varimathras
sections.body: Varimathras waits in the Undercity to hear what business brings you. The small scroll is in your hands, and he expects your matter to be important.

faq.answer: The small scroll is meant for Varimathras in the Undercity.

faq.q: Where do I take the small scroll?
faq.answer: Take the small scroll to Varimathras in the Undercity.

faq.q: What does Varimathras want to hear about?
faq.answer: Varimathras asks what business you wish to speak of.

attribution: In-game quest text: An Unholy Alliance
